# django-asklens 0.3.2 — draft release notes

**Unpublished candidate; not publication authorization.** Public `0.3.1`
remains current until separately authorized publication and public verification.
No tag, release date, public artifact hashes, or final release commit is claimed.
These repository-only notes must remain excluded from wheel and sdist.

## Highlights

- A clearer local evaluation journey: synthetic offline data, exact suggested
  questions, useful grouped results, readable scoped empty/error/help states,
  troubleshooting, cleanup, and a transition to host-owned registration.
- Real browser showcase screenshots and a short captioned recording with a text
  walkthrough, accurately labeled synthetic and deterministic.
- Navigable documentation, strict rendered-site validation, and build-only CI.
  Pages deployment and outreach remain separate operator decisions.
- A fail-closed artifact-handoff verifier before the protected PyPI upload.
- Advisory fixes in the development lock for certifi, Django REST Framework,
  FastMCP/fastmcp-slim, and OpenTelemetry API, with required transitive updates.
  Runtime bounds are unchanged: hosts must audit their resolved dependencies.

## Compatibility and upgrades

Proposed patch scope under the existing narrow 0.3.x policy. Relative to public
`v0.3.1`, the preparation baseline changes no package Python execution code,
governed interfaces, packaged schemas, or migrations. The provisional frontend
changes do not introduce another execution path. No public API, migration,
data transformation, or support-line expansion is introduced.

Authenticated public `0.3.1` is the immediate upgrade origin. Public `0.3.0` and
`0.2.0` remain separately checked older origins; `0.1.0a1` is unsupported.
Candidate probes use disposable environments and preserve synthetic audit data
and the exact existing migration graph. Run host-specific application checks
and back up before upgrading; no migration does not promise safe rollback.

## Verification required before publication

Full local tests/lint/audit, Django/migration checks, docs validation, isolated
candidate core/API/MCP installs, authenticated-origin upgrades, relevant
PostgreSQL and real Playwright/API/MCP checks, package-content checks, and
exact-final-head hosted CI/CodeQL remain release gates. Preparation results
must be recorded as local evidence, never substituted for final/public hashes.

## Limits

Alpha only. Offline fixtures do not establish live-provider quality, arbitrary
natural-language support, external adoption, production capacity, or independent
security certification. Existing host authentication, permissions, trusted row
scope, rate limits/timeouts, and deployment controls remain host-owned.

Publication requires separate authorization of the exact reviewed commit/tag,
normal protected-environment approval, and authenticated post-publication
verification. Never move existing tags, replace public files, upload manually,
or bypass Trusted Publishing. See `docs/release-preparation-0.3.2.md` and the
release runbook for candidate status and operator gates.
